bio: With views across the Firth of Forth and Bass Rock, the Marine Hotel is known as the ‘Grand Old Lady’ of North Berwick.  Following a major refurbishment the Marine Hotel is back to her former glory, with sumptuous and cosy interiors, perfect for an Afternoon Tea on Scotland's golf coast.  Afternoon Tea is served in the Bass Rock Bar and Lounge, which pays tribute to this spectacular natural attraction, and offers unrivalled views of the iconic volcanic rock, which has been settled for over 800 years.  Enjoy a tradtional Afternoon Tea menu, which includes Smoked Salmon sandwiches and Pork & Haggis Sausage Rolls. Warm scones are served with raspberry jam and clotted cream.  The selection of sweet treats includes Ginger, Lemon & Clove Macaroon and Chocolate & Caramel Cake. Choose from a selection of speciality teas including Earl Grey, Jade Tips and Chocolate Noir.  Afternoon Tea costs £29.50 per per or £39.50 per person with a glass of Champagne.
